evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, DEPENDENCY_RE matches only the listed unit dependency directives and omits systemd's stop-propagation directives `PropagatesStopTo=` and `StopPropagatedFrom=`. A co-installed unit that stop-propagates to the selected crq unit would therefore evade the dependency scan, so the live-binding discovery can incorrectly treat the selected unit as supported/independent even though stopping the other unit also stops it. Adding both directive names to the existing alternation is the smallest-compatible correctness repair; no owner decision is needed.
